H_protocol: H1 literal source-plane compatible acts; H2 actual dispositional amplification with intensity-transfer limits; H3 behavior too local-punchline-bound to generalize; H4 actual nonliteral behavioral license. Magic, lies, performance, possession, artificial bodies, survival, wrong predictions and uncertain causes are not automatic H3/H4. Actual harm remains harm at H2. Selected records have no population denominator or category quota.
L_protocol: L0 portable proposition; L1 material wording/rhythm/tone; L2 pragmatics/register/recipient force; L3 central Japanese-form dependence requiring reconstruction or annotation. Ordinary ruby, a cultural reference or a magical term is not automatically L3.
